plusGridSquareTilesDescription: Use balanced 1:1 square launcher tiles instead of taller portrait cards
plusGridCardlessStyleDescription: Float app icons and labels directly on the canvas without outer card boxes
plusGridAmbientIconHaloDescription: Project a soft radial color glow behind app icons on grid and list tiles
plusGridShowSourceBadgeDescription: Show the repository source icon next to version pills on app tiles
privilegedOpsDesc: Choose how Obtainium+ runs system actions. Auto tries Shizuku, then root, then the normal Android prompt. If a privileged route fails, the normal prompt is used instead. Dhizuku can only help with installs.
privilegedOpUninstallDesc: Used when you remove an app and tick "uninstall too". System shows Android's own dialog.
privilegedOpBatteryDesc: Lets Obtainium+ run background update checks reliably without asking each time.
pinningAppliesToConfiguredHosts: Pinning is applied to hosts with an enabled pin set. Other hosts use Android's certificate store.
pinningCurrentlyDisabled: Certificate pinning is currently off, so these certificates are not being used.
pinningCurrentlyEnabled: Certificate pinning is currently on for the listed hosts.
pinningDisabledUsesAndroidStore: All requests use Android's certificate store. Built-in and custom pin sets are still editable.
pinningEnabledNoHosts: Pinning is enabled, but no hosts have certificates. All requests use Android's certificate store.
pinSetBuiltInOverrideHelp: Your pin sets take precedence over built-in pins for overlapping hosts.
pinSetHostOverlap: Host {} conflicts with another pin set at the same specificity.
pinSetIdExists: A pin set with this ID already exists.
pinSetIntroDescription: Only the certificates in this pin set are trusted for its hosts. Other hosts keep using Android's certificate store.
pinSetOverridesBuiltInConfirmation: This pin set covers built-in hosts: {}. Your certificates will replace the built-in roots for those hosts while pinning is enabled. Continue?
pinStoreInvalidFormat: Pinned certificate store has an unsupported format.
pinStoreLoadFailed: Pinned certificate store could not be loaded
pinStoreUnsupportedVersion: Pinned certificate store version {} is not supported.
builtInPinOverriddenDescription: Your pin set takes precedence for this host while it exists.
builtInPinRemovedDescription: While pinning is enabled, this host uses another matching pin set, or Android's certificate store if none applies.
builtInPinSetsDescription: Provided by Obtainium. You can remove certificates or hosts and restore them at any time.
certificatePinningAdditiveHelp: To trust a certificate in addition to Android's built-in certificates, install it in Android Settings → Security → Encryption & credentials. Adding it here replaces Android's trust for the selected hosts.
certificatePinningExclusiveHelp: For hosts in a pin set, Obtainium trusts only the certificates in that set and ignores Android's certificate store. Other hosts still use Android's trust store.
certificatePinningRedirectHelp: Redirects to hosts that are not pinned are verified using Android's certificate store.
deletePinSetConfirmation: Delete the pin set "{}"? While pinning is enabled, its hosts will use another matching pin set, or Android's certificate store if none applies.
includeSubdomainsHelp: Also apply this pin to every subdomain of this host.
invalidCertificate: Invalid certificate. Use a PEM or DER X.509 certificate.
invalidHost: Invalid host name. Enter a host such as example.com.
noPinnedCertificatesDescription: Upload a PEM or DER certificate to create this pin set.
noUserPinSetsDescription: Add a pin set to replace Android's trust for specific hosts.
removeBuiltInCertificateConfirmation: Remove {} from the built-in pin for {}?
removeBuiltInPinConfirmation: Remove the built-in pin for {}? While pinning is enabled, another matching pin set will be used, or Android's certificate store if none applies.
removeLastBuiltInCertificateConfirmation: Remove the last certificate ({})? While pinning is enabled, {} will use another matching pin set, or Android's certificate store if none applies.
restoreAllBuiltInPinsConfirmation: Restore all built-in hosts and certificates to the versions shipped with this app?
tooManyCertificates: Too many certificates. The limit is 50.
galaxyStoreInstallSourceRequiresShizuku: Setting Samsung Galaxy Store as the installation source requires Shizuku or Root. Dhizuku is not supported.
